title: Crisafulli insists on more shark nets to protect human lives despite trapped mother and baby whale
summary: Queensland premier says he won’t protect whales ‘at the expense of one single human’ Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Queensland’s premier said the state is “not for turning” on its plan to expand shark netting, and won’t put protecting whales “at the expense of one single human”.
